ValidationRule.description: Insert-scoped stand-in for a required lookup; ISNEW()-scoped so SetNull on Lead delete is not blocked. A row must name a winner as either a Lead (open) or an Opportunity (converted) - the platform rejects a lookup set to a converted Lead.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A broker submission must name a winner as either a Lead (pre-conversion) or an Opportunity (post-conversion).
